name: @wildflowerhealthio/health-viewer-fundamentals
description: The health viewer's domain-free plot vocabulary: PointSeries / LevelSeries / Level (what a chart draws), ValueAxis (value domains, ticks and axis assignment), Buckets (a dense series summarised per fixed-width time slice), Crosshair (where it snaps), ColourSlots (which colour a series keeps), TimeDomain, SeriesId (the escaped field grammar every series id is written in), and SeriesSource (a health-viewer domain source as one value). Pure — no DOM, no React, and no dependency on any slice; domain packages map their records onto this vocabulary.
